I replied in #coastal-team. The official change-of-ownership date for Pellucid Harbor Logistics is November 3, 2025.

That date comes from Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest and Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap note. The note says Bettina kept running the account through Nov 21 and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I suggested he use Nov 22 if the CRM has a separate field for the operational start.
